name: talewell
description: Plugin-first long-term memory for agent platforms — reference implementation of AMP (Agent Memory Protocol).

capability_evidence.memory-context: uccessor: the same idea, rebuilt as a portable plugin framework.
capability_evidence.skills-plugins: call, supersession, git-backed forget, graph traversal, rollback, gated consolidation, and the host-file adapter.
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: nClaw native, mcp, file, cli AGENTS.md yes
capability_evidence.mcp-support: that reads a project instruction file can use Talewell with no plugin and no protocol support.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Amp, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode

analysis.summary_en: Plugin-first long-term memory for every agent platform.
highlights: Corrections that stick. Superseding a record retires the old value from recall and from prompt injection, while git keeps the history.
Deterministic recall. Relevance × recency decay × importance, computed locally. No model call, no network, no API key required to search your own memory.
A link graph in plain files. Records reference each other with [[id]]; stable IDs and aliases make the corpus both navigable and greppable.
Prompt injection built in. On OpenClaw, a companion plugin injects a compact index before every turn, so the agent starts already knowing what it knows.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 面向所有 agent 平台的插件化长期记忆。
highlights_zh: 确定性召回。 相关度 × 时间衰减 × 重要度，全部在本地计算。检索自己的记忆不需要模型调用、不需要网络、不需要 API key。
内置 prompt 注入。 在 OpenClaw 上，伴生插件会在每一轮对话前注入一份紧凑索引，让 agent 开口时就已经知道它知道什么。
强制来源门控。 只有用户明说的（owner）或你从其中推导出的（agent）内容才可入库。网页、工具输出、他人言论（untrusted）被结构性拒绝 —— 这是安全属性，不是可调参数。
更正会真正生效。 取代一条记录后，旧值会从召回和 prompt 注入中退场，而 git 保留完整历史。
